Product grooming pass, 2026-11-15 23:40 MST. Approval decisions are yours; this is what I found.

Acceptance added (these were the only non-review drafts without it):
- BUG-2607: retained:dirty notice on every early lane terminal path, with a test per path.
- BUG-2625: resume re-binds the seat or warns with the relaunch command; dead-runner deputy jobs become terminal. AC3 overlaps TASK-3801 item 2 (commented on both).
- SPIKE-715: output is a sketch with move/leave/drop per piece, a comparison with the TASK-1067 crate split, BUG-MN-* triage, and your signoff before any code.

Suggested dispositions:
- Reject TASK-3800 as a duplicate of TASK-3104 (approved). Its own text says to fold it there.
- Approve first: BUG-2605 (lib test red on main, plus 5 dell1-ambient failures; it adds noise to every promotion gate), BUG-2623 (seat_clone flakes under parallel load), BUG-2620 (high; seat:integration mail refused).
- Approve next: BUG-2625, BUG-2619, BUG-2607, TASK-3801, TASK-3803, TASK-3804. All are small, with tests named.
- Hold: TASK-3806 (waits for TASK-3119 step 2a on main), TASK-3807 (a pipeline-depth knob; I think it needs a sketch), SPIKE-715 (needs a sketch first).
- I left the 18 "Review PR-N" draft stories alone. They are review trackers, not product intake.

Wave status: 43 approved, and the implementer queue head is BUG-2618 rework. The wave has enough work queued, so I am not launching anything.
subject: Product: draft inbox groomed; dispositions suggested
